visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a bubbling pot of thick shrimp congee. A metal spoon stirs the mixture, revealing tender rice grains and large, succulent pieces of peeled shrimp. The lighting is bright and warm, reflecting off the glossy surface of the congee. (2) The scene cuts to a preparation phase where shrimp shells, a halved onion, and a large chunk of carrot are placed in a deep stainless steel pot. A hand pours clear water over the ingredients, which are partially submerged. (3) The ingredients are shown boiling vigorously, with the water turning into a rich, orange-tinted broth. The camera remains at a high-angle medium close-up, focusing on the movement within the pot. (4) A golden-yellow liquid is strained through a fine-mesh sieve into a black pot. The liquid is clear and vibrant, indicating a concentrated stock. (5) Raw white rice grains are added to the boiling stock, swirling in the center. The camera zooms in slightly to emphasize the texture of the grains. (6) A hand adds a large handful of shredded cabbage to the pot. The cabbage is pale green and crisp, floating on the surface of the yellow liquid. (7) A spoonful of cooked white rice is added to the pot to thicken the mixture further. The steam rises from the pot, indicating high heat. (8) Dried mushrooms and more fresh shrimp are added to the congee. The shrimp are translucent and grey, turning pink as they cook. (9) The final scene shows the completed congee in a black bowl. Chopped green onions are sprinkled on top, adding a vibrant green contrast to the yellow-brown base. The congee is thick and hearty.
